oracleRisk.summary: M0 mints $M only against permissioned Minters' offchain eligible collateral whose USD value is attested onchain by threshold Validators inside MinterGateway. The protocol publishes no external price feed and no borrower-liquidation branch: issuance is bounded by the governance-set mint ratio applied to validator-attested collateral value, with propose-delay-execute minting, validator freeze and mint-cancellation powers as the risk controls. M is therefore valued through a privileged internal valuation authority rather than an independent market oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: M0's issuer documentation describes collateral update, mint and retrieval as MinterGateway flows gated by multiple Validator signatures and governance parameters. It describes no price feed, collateral-health oracle, borrower market or forced-liquidation path whose branch would need separate oracle review. The only price-sensitive input is the offchain collateral value attested by permissioned Validators, so the review stays top-level and no borrower-collateral branch is applicable.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: M remains Upstream on its full eligible-collateral category, not a currently measured97.9% UMB allocation. The M0 API retrieval2026-10-19 reports $193,516,539.864742 collateral with source date2026-09-21T15:32:11Z; the protocol documents offchain approved collateral held through eligible custody structures. Internal cash/Treasury/token and provider weights are unavailable, so100% is categorical custody exposure, not a fresh constituent-level audit. Ethereum MToken0x866a2bf4e572cbcf37d5071a7a58503bfb36be1b is immutable, mint/burn restricted to immutable MinterGateway0xf7f9638cb444d65e5a40bf5ff98ebe4ff319f04e; gateway burnM burns caller tokens, not arbitrary holders. Sources https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/0x866a2bf4e572cbcf37d5071a7a58503bfb36be1b and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m0-platform/protocol/main/src/MinterGateway.sol. Solana mint mzerokyEX9TNDoK4o2YZQBDmMzjokAeN6M2g2S3pLJo at finalized458738579 has freezeAuthority=null and no default frozen-state extension; transferHook has null program but retained update authority. Solana7.4146% and Monad8.721% are sub-material under the census; their dormant hook/upgrade surfaces do not set the asset verdict. Only Ethereum82.9139% is material and has no direct holder-control surface. No declared parent; full collateral category qualifies upstream. Exact historical UMB concentration is not refreshed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: M0 has one native issuer on Ethereum; its other reviewed deployments, including Solana, are bridge representations. M Portals use Ethereum hub lock/release and spoke mint/burn; current Portal V2 documentation lists Wormhole, Hyperlane, and LayerZero bridge adapters, while the Solana Portal uses Wormhole NTT. The Solana 1-of-2 inbound mint multisig and Portal program upgrade EOA are route-scoped Bridge Risk controls, not native M mint authority; the remaining EVM route machinery stays represented by the reviewed route inventory.

controls.label: M Solana inbound mint multisig

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Solana M is a spoke deployment bridged from Ethereum M; base supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The SPL mint authority is a 1-of-2 SPL multisig whose signers are off-curve PDAs controlled by M0 portal/allied programs.
routeChecks.caps: Effective Solana mint capacity is bounded by the portal route and base M supply, not by an immutable Solana token cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: M0 Solana programs share upgrade authority 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW; extension authorities point to the same EOA where checked.

controls.capDescription: Solana M is a spoke deployment bridged from Ethereum M through the M0 portal/transceiver design; base supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway. The SPL Token-2022 mintAuthority is a 1-of-2 SPL multisig (ms2SCrTYioPuumF6oBvReXoVRizEW5qYkiVuUEak7Th) whose two signers are off-curve PDAs controlled by M0 Portal and allied programs; all programs share upgrade authority 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 452226596 on 2026-10-01, the M Token-2022 mint reported this 1-of-2 SPL multisig as mintAuthority, with numRequiredSigners = 1 and numValidSigners = 2; its signers were 9vSE2CHNE54ENdAVG3r8dkthXNVWtEyZdXXEFnVN1a8H and BQdqsDuByTYYeDp92ar7guMFD1P4FTWXJPP1WMq2rUXm. The first signer corrects a case-sensitive transcription in the earlier evidence text. The mint had null freezeAuthority and metadata linking it to Ethereum M 0x866A2BF4E572CbcF37D5071A7a58503Bfb36be1b. Historical route analysis treats these signers as program-derived authorities constrained by Portal execution; that cap interpretation is retained without claiming a newly measured limit. The separately observed Portal ProgramData upgrade authority remains 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW.

controls.label: M0 Solana Portal program upgrade authority
bypassSurfaces: The Solana Portal upgrade authority can replace bridge logic and alter or bypass current inbound mint constraints without an independent delay.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439805516, the Portal program account mzp1q2j5Hr1QuLC3KFBCAUz5aUckT6qyuZKZ3WJnMmY resolved to ProgramData GBcoKgAkTQ5ZYJM2PzsjhRnDfkwBcgx7hapcAJjrcu5n, whose upgradeable-loader state named this EOA as authority. It can replace the Portal logic and thereby change or bypass current Solana route constraints, so canRaiseCap is true for the bridge route; this is bridge upgrade authority, not Ethereum native M mint authority.
